newsitem.title: UK: P&O gains after SBC Warburg recommendation.
newsitem.headline: P&O gains after SBC Warburg recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co Plc rose on Wednesday, responding to a recommendation on the stock earlier this week from analysts at SBC Warburg, dealers said.
The stock was up 12-1/2p at 633-1/2 by 1056 GMT in volume of 1.3 million shares.
The stock also benefited from Tuesday's safety report on Eurotunnel Plc, which stopped short of ordering a change to its open-sided freight wagons.

The findings were seen as helping avoid the bankruptcy which analysts say would be bad news for rival ferry services, because it could draw a line under Eurotunnel's debt burden, leaving it in a new competitive position.
